phase_statuses.title: Backend Scheduler Dashboard Query API
phase_statuses.objective: Implement a single backend query endpoint that returns all dashboard metrics and chart data for a date range.
phase_statuses.evidence_expectation: backend query response samples, validation command output, and code references for calculation rules.

acceptance_criteria.text: API validates `start_date` and `end_date` (`YYYY-MM-DD`) and rejects invalid range with explicit error.
API response includes these top-level groups: `range`, `summary`, `daily_capacity`, `material_consumption`.
`summary` includes order completion rate, equipment failure rate, and total capacity values sourced from real tables only.
Equipment failure rate uses explicit rule `machine_count < required_machines` on daily capacity rows within selected range.

phase_statuses.notes: - Backend scheduler dashboard API implemented and validated.

phase_statuses.title: Frontend Dashboard Page and Charts
phase_statuses.objective: Add a scheduler dashboard UI with default one-month filter, metric cards, and chart sections.
phase_statuses.evidence_expectation: UI screenshots and real-browser traces showing dashboard rendering and filter updates.

acceptance_criteria.text: Scheduler can access dashboard route from sidebar; non-scheduler roles cannot access it.
Dashboard defaults to one-month range and allows custom start/end date query.
Dashboard renders required KPI cards and chart blocks:
Charts use bar/pie format and render non-empty labels/values when data exists.

phase_statuses.notes: - Scheduler dashboard UI, charts, routing, and styling implemented.

phase_statuses.title: Dashboard Validation and Regression
phase_statuses.objective: Validate the dashboard using real browser E2E and targeted regression checks.
phase_statuses.evidence_expectation: Playwright run output and generated evidence artifacts in `fronted/test-results/`.

acceptance_criteria.text: Playwright includes at least one scheduler dashboard case that verifies route access and required KPI/chart presence.
Regression checks for existing scheduler flow still pass after dashboard integration.

phase_statuses.notes: - Dashboard E2E and regression validation passed in real browser.
